    end)

-- Wallhop Macro State & Front-Facing Detection Loop
local wallhopActive = false
local wallhopConn = nil

addEzButton("Toggle Wallhop Macro", function()
    wallhopActive = not wallhopActive
    if wallhopActive then
        wallhopConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then return end

            local forwardPos = hrp.Position + (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 3) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            local params = OverlapParams.new()
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            
            local scanCFrame = CFrame.new(forwardPos)
            local scanSize = Vector3.new(3, 4, 3)
            local frontParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(scanCFrame, scanSize, params)
            
            local stackedPartsCount = 0
            for _, part in ipairs(frontParts) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    stackedPartsCount = stackedPartsCount + 1
                end
            end

            if stackedPartsCount >= 2 then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                
                local targetCF = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(frontParts[1].Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, frontParts[1].Position.Z))
                local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                
                TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCF}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(Camera, tweenInfo, {CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-15, 15)), 0)}):Play()
            end
        end)
        print("[EzLoad]: Wallhop Macro ENABLED.")
    else
        if wallhopConn then
            wallhopConn:Disconnect()
            wallhopConn = nil
        end
        print("[EzLoad]: Wallhop Macro DISABLED.")
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 8. ESP & TRACER SYSTEM
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local espDrawings = {}

local function createESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then return end
    local drawings = {
        Box = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    }
    drawings.Box.Visible = false
    drawings.Box.Thickness = 1.5
    drawings.Box.Filled = false
    drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
    drawings.Tracer.Thickness = 1.5
    espDrawings[player] = drawings
end

local function removeESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then
        for _, drawing in pairs(espDrawings[player]) do
            drawing:Remove()
        end
        espDrawings[player] = nil
    end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESP)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if not espDrawings[player] then
                createESP(player)
            end
            
            local drawings = espDrawings[player]
            local char = player.Character
            local rootPart = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            
            local isTeammate = NexusConfig.TeamCheck and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
            
            if NexusConfig.ESP_Enabled and char and rootPart and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and not isTeammate then
                local vector, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
                
                if onScreen then
                    if NexusConfig.Box_Enabled then
                        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                        if head then
                            local headPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
                            local legPos = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
                            local height = math.abs(headPos.Y - legPos.Y)
                            local width = height / 2
                            
                            drawings.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
                            drawings.Box.Position = Vector2.new(vector.X - width / 2, headPos.Y)
                            drawings.Box.Color = NexusConfig.ESP_Color
                            drawings.Box.Visible = true
                        end
                    else
                        drawings.Box.Visible = false
                    end
                    
                    if NexusConfig.Tracers_Enabled then
                        local viewportSize = Camera.ViewportSize
                        local origin = Vector2.new(viewportSize.X / 2, viewportSize.Y)
                        
                        drawings.Tracer.From = origin
                        drawings.Tracer.To = Vector2.new(vector.X, vector.Y)
                        drawings.Tracer.Color = NexusConfig.ESP_Color
                        drawings.Tracer.Visible = true
                    else
                        drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
                    end
                else
                    drawings.Box.Visible = false
                    drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
                end
            else
                drawings.Box.Visible = false
                drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 9. SMART PLAYER FINDER
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function findPlayer(query)
    if not query or query == "" then return nil end
    query = string.lower(query)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.lower(player.Name) == query or string.lower(player.DisplayName) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.sub(nameLower, 1, #query) == query or string.sub(displayLower, 1, #query) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.find(nameLower, query, 1, true) or string.find(displayLower, query, 1, true) then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

local Commands = {}

-- Fly State Variables
local flying = false
local flySpeed = 50
local flyConnection = nil
local bg, bv

local function startFly()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    if flying then stopFly() end
    flying = true
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bv.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not char or not hrp.Parent then return end
        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local moveDir = Vector3.new()

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        bv.velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
        bg.cframe = camCF
    end)
    logMessage("Fly mode: ENABLED", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120))
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").PlatformStand = false
    end
    if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
    logMessage("Fly mode: DISABLED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
end

commandTextBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if not enterPressed then return end
    local rawText = commandTextBox.Text
    commandTextBox.Text = ""
    if #rawText == 0 then return end
    
    logMessage("> " .. rawText, Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220))
    
    local cleanText = rawText
    if string.sub(cleanText, 1, 1) == "." or string.sub(cleanText, 1, 1) == "/" then
        cleanText = string.sub(cleanText, 2)
    end
    
    local args = {}
    for word in string.gmatch(cleanText, "%S+") do table.insert(args, word) end
    local cmdName = string.lower(table.remove(args, 1) or "")
    
    if Commands[cmdName] then
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            Commands[cmdName].Callback(args)
        end)
        if not success then
            logMessage("Execution fault: " .. tostring(err), Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
        end
    else
        logMessage("Unknown directive: '" .. cmdName .. "'. Type 'help'.", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
    end
    commandTextBox:CaptureFocus()
end)

local isMainVisible = true
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete then
        isMainVisible = not isMainVisible
        local twInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
        if isMainVisible then
            mainFrame.Visible = true
            TweenService:Create(mainFrame, twInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}):Play()
            TweenService:Create(uiStroke, twInfo, {Transparency = 0.1}):Play()
            commandTextBox:CaptureFocus()
        else
            local tw = TweenService:Create(mainFrame, twInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
            TweenService:Create(uiStroke, twInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            tw:Play()
            tw.Completed:Connect(function()
                if not isMainVisible then mainFrame.Visible = false end
            end)
        end
    end
end)
